hotel.name: Hotel Atrium
hotel.tagline: Serenity in the Heart of Lakeside Pokhara
hotel.heroHeading: A Peaceful Oasis by Phewa Lake
hotel.heroSubheading: Situated on tranquil Uday Marg just a 3-minute stroll from Phewa Lake, Hotel Atrium blends genuine Nepali hospitality with modern comfort, scenic rooftop Himalayan vistas, and lush courtyard gardens.
hotel.aboutStory:
Nestled in the vibrant yet peaceful enclave of Uday Marg in Lakeside Pokhara, Hotel Atrium has welcomed travelers, trekkers, and families from around the globe seeking comfort, tranquility, and warm Nepali hospitality.

Our hotel is strategically located away from the immediate traffic noise of the main lakeside strip, yet within a short 3-minute walk to the pristine waters of Phewa Lake, the bustling lakeside promenade, waterfront cafes, and craft bazaars.

Guests at Hotel Atrium enjoy bright, well-appointed guest rooms featuring private balconies, ensuite bathrooms with uninterrupted 24-hour hot showers, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Our garden courtyard and rooftop terrace provide the perfect retreat to sip freshly brewed Himalayan coffee while gazing upon the majestic peaks of the Annapurna range and Mount Machhapuchhre (Fishtail).

Whether you are gearing up for the Annapurna Circuit, unwinding after a Himalayan trek, or exploring the cultural wonders of Pokhara, our dedicated 24-hour reception and travel desk are always on hand to ensure an unforgettable stay.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows are subject to a 1-night charge.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed on the hotel premises to ensure the comfort and safety of all guests.
policies.smoking: All indoor guest rooms and enclosed public areas are 100% smoke-free. Designated smoking zones are available in the open-air garden terrace.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Children under 6 stay free of charge when sharing existing bedding with parents.

rooms.name: Standard Twin Room with Fan
rooms.tagline: As featured on Agoda (ID: 908532) & EaseMyTrip — Budget comfort
rooms.description: Our Standard Twin Room features two comfortable single beds with clean, fresh linens, an ensuite private bathroom with 24-hour hot solar shower, a work desk, ceiling fan, and large windows bringing in natural Nepali sunlight.
rooms.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival

rooms.name: Deluxe Double Room with Balcony
rooms.tagline: Our most popular room for couples and travelers
rooms.description: Designed for relaxation, the Deluxe Double Room offers a spacious king/queen-sized bed, a private balcony facing the peaceful neighborhood or mountain silhouette, flat-screen cable TV, bedside reading lights, and an immaculate private bathroom.
rooms.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival

rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room with Balcony
rooms.tagline: Spacious comfort with separate beds and private balcony
rooms.description: Ideal for trekking partners or friends traveling together in Pokhara. Features two premium single beds with orthopaedic mattresses, private balcony, private bathroom with high-pressure hot water, cable television, and scenic hillside glimpses.
rooms.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival

rooms.name: Deluxe Himalayan View Suite
rooms.tagline: Elevated comfort with panoramic Annapurna mountain vistas
rooms.description: Our signature top-floor suite boasts uninterrupted panoramic views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) and the Annapurna range. Features a king bed plus an extra single bed, private living lounge area, private sun terrace, mini-refrigerator, and deluxe bathroom amenities.
rooms.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival
